text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: The paper is a non-review research article focused on species distribution modeling of the camel tick Hyalomma dromedarii in Saudi Arabia and the UAE using MaxEnt. Although it uses land use/land cover (LULC) as an input environmental variable (contributing 53.1% to model), LULC prediction or simulation is not the primary objective. The study does not implement any LULC prediction or future LULC scenarios; instead, it uses a static 2020 LULC layer as a predictor for tick habitat suitability. It fails core inclusion criteria because: (1) the primary focus is ecological/species distribution, not LULC prediction; (2) it does not simulate or project future LULC changes under any scenario; and (3) while it models future tick distributions under climate scenarios (ssp2-4.5 for 2040/2060), LULC is excluded from future projections and held constant. Thus, it meets the exclusion criterion “Species-specific/ecological focus unrelated to LULC” and lacks any LULC prediction component.)
